newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuela to repatriate Spaniards, Canadians.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela to repatriate Spaniards, Canadians.

text.p: Five Spaniards convicted of drug trafficking in Venezuela will be repatriated Wednesday as part of a programme to reduce prison overcrowding, a top Justice Ministry official said on Tuesday.
A group of Canadian prisoners would also leave this week, Antonio Marval, head of prisoners' rights at the ministry, told Reuters. He did not say how many Canadians would be repatriated.
The Spanish prisoners, all convicted of trying to smuggle small quantities of cocaine out of the country, have already spent on average five years behind bars in Venezuela, Marval said.
About 3,000 of Venezuela's 25,000 inmates are foreigners. Of the foreigners, 1,700 are Colombian, Marval said.
